items.q: I made the first bebop records for Savoy with Bud Powell

ctx.x: Yeah, I know. We are going to get into that but what I was interested in was the period in New York from say, '39 to '45 because this is a period in which bebop or modern jazz, whatever, came up, and you know, the sessions uptown which have been written about so much and talked about started around you know, '39 or '41, I guess and then you know, Dizzy Gillespie and Charlie Parker, Bud Powell, The- lonious Monk, this was all happening in this same period and during the war.
